scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run compile && npm run package:frontend && npm run initialize
scripts.build:frontend: cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.package:frontend: rm -rf dist/public && cp -R ../frontend/dist dist/public && test -f dist/public/index.html && grep -q "./assets/" dist/public/index.html && ! grep -q "/src/main.tsx" dist/public/index.html && echo "Verified frontend production assets"
scripts.initialize: npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.compile: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && test -f dist/main.js && echo 'Verified entry: dist/main.js'
